subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Which public contract, if any, should OpenClaw expose for disabling built-in skill source roots such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but the fix adds public `skills.load` configuration and changes built-in skill-source behavior, which the repository policy treats as maintainer-owned product/API direction.

options.title: Add typed `disabledSources`
options.body: Expose a narrow list of known built-in skill source ids, defaulting to current behavior and skipping disabled sources before discovery and watcher registration.

options.title: Add personal-source toggle
options.body: Expose a smaller boolean for `~/.agents/skills` only, reducing API surface but leaving project-agent and future source opt-outs unresolved.

options.title: Keep current loading model
options.body: Decline new source-level config and document per-agent skill allowlists, prompt limits, and per-skill disables as the supported controls.

recommendation.title: Add typed `disabledSources`
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow list of known built-in skill source ids, defaulting to current behavior and skipping disabled sources before discovery and watcher registration.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the watcher, docs, and config side of the skills surface and is a practical owner for the API-shape decision.
